clips.title: The story
paras: In Old Town, soldiers train beside weathered tenements and crowded alleys. The quarter largely survived the First War and remains home to Stormwind’s military Command Center and the covert headquarters of SI:7.

Old Town keeps much of the shape of Stormwind before the First War. While the Stonemasons rebuilt the rest of the city from the ground up, this quarter escaped total ruin. It never gained the pristine marble facades and grand canals found in the Trade District and Cathedral Square. Working folk, laborers, and the city’s poorest residents live among its crowded tenements. Its cobbled streets are narrower, dirtier, and more chaotic than those elsewhere in the capital, preserving the feel of the old kingdom.

Old Town holds Stormwind’s military officers, barracks, and combat trainers in the Command Center. Nearby, the Champions’ Hall gathers the Alliance’s finest warriors. At the district’s edge, SI:7 keeps its covert compound under the leadership of Master Mathias Shaw. Off-duty footmen and shadowy operatives meet at the Pig and Whistle Tavern, one of the city’s liveliest watering holes.
